My tomato leaves are already curling - will this pesticide help? Tomato leaf curl can be physiological or pathological. Physiological causes: high temperature/drought causes upward curling - provide shade, water regularly, loosen soil. Overwatering causes downward curling - stop watering, loosen soil. Fertilizer damage - flush soil with water; nutrient deficiency (potassium/boron) - supplement. Pathological causes: viral disease - spray insecticide to eliminate aphids/whiteflies as vectors. Insect damage - spray Imidacloprid for aphids/whiteflies; Abamectin for spider mites.
